items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: I played with Danny. See, I don't remember who was in the band... I went with Danny's band, Danny White's.

ctx.x: It was in the quarters, but I'm saying it's mostly whites went to see you.

Yeah, that's what it was. I mean, yeah. It was catered to whites, tourists and all of them. The tourists and everybody else. We played. But you know, that's all we did, we played. We just had to perform. Let me see, I played that with Danny White too. Okay, because you had to know Danny. Yeah, and then later on when Truje, he was a piano player for Danny White. Now he was a pharmacy. While he was gone with Danny's band, he went to Xavier College to become a pharmacist in his spare time and he became
a pharmacist. What was his first name? Leonard. Leonard Truje. Okay, I've heard the name but I didn't know.
